annotation_proposal.confidence: HIGH for the visible-event description; not eligible as occluded hidden-state gold
annotation_proposal.reason: The interesting Standard fact is a visible transfer into the hand, then a visible load under a transparent cup, then a reveal. Nothing stays occluded from the camera.
